plugins.name: WorkBuddy
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI: multi-account login, dynamic models, chat executor, CN daily check-in, Global one-shot expert trial (manual), credit lifecycle (disable CN / delete Global when exhausted), credits panel with CN/Global filters, optional credits-aware scheduler.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss

plugins.name: Qoder
plugins.description: Qoder provider for CLIProxyAPI with Global (qoder.sh) and CN (qoder.com.cn) support, OAuth and PAT login, dynamic models, streaming chat, CN daily check-in, token keepalive, lifecycle management, and an accounts panel.
plugins.author: SadPull

plugins.name: CPA Model Visibility
plugins.description: Per-API-key /v1/models catalog filtering for CLIProxyAPI: each downstream key only sees the models it is allowed to. Rules live in config.yaml (allow/deny patterns on model id and owned_by, hot-reloaded), managed from a web panel; request-level enforcement stays with key-billing.
plugins.author: SadPull
